public.public_event_inventory.definition:
SELECT e.id,
    e.title,
    e.slug,
    e.short_description,
    e.description,
    e.start_at,
    e.end_at,
    e.timezone,
    e.location,
    e.room,
    e.type,
    e.level,
    e.image_url,
    e.image_media_id,
    e.event_link,
    e.registration_url,
    e.google_form_url,
    e.google_event_url,
    e.registration_type,
    e.registration_enabled,
    e.max_participants,
    e.is_featured,
    e.prerequisites,
    e.what_youll_learn,
    e.what_to_bring,
    e.schedule,
    e.additional_info,
    e.contact_info,
    e.publication_status,
    e.published_at,
    e.updated_at,
    e.created_at,
    e.revision,
    state.registration_state,
        CASE state.registration_state
            WHEN 'open'::text THEN 0
            WHEN 'full'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'closed'::text THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END AS registration_priority,
    e.previous_start_at
   FROM events e
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS internal_count
           FROM event_attendance r
          WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.max_participants IS NOT NULL AND e.registration_enabled AND COALESCE(e.end_at, e.start_at) > now()) a ON true
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT e.registration_enabled THEN 'closed'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(e.end_at, e.start_at) <= now() THEN 'ended'::text
                    WHEN e.max_participants IS NOT NULL AND (a.internal_count + e.external_attendees) >= e.max_participants THEN 'full'::text
                    ELSE 'open'::text
                END AS registration_state) state
  WHERE e.publication_status = 'published'::text;
